title: Combinatorial group testing

problem.name: Combinatorial group testing
problem.statement_latex: Given an unknown defective set $S\subseteq[n]$ of size at most $k$, a test on $T\subseteq[n]$ returns $[T\cap S\ne\varnothing]$. Recover $S$ with constant success probability; tests may be queried coherently.

quantum.headline_latex: $\Theta(\sqrt k)$ queries by Belovs' adversary-bound learner; efficient implementations have additional polynomial or near-linear dependence on the test description length.
